boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Harvey Mudd traditions and recurring campus practices, including historic practices clearly labeled as such.

cards.title: Fill out a Hoch Heart
cards.subtitle: Hoch-Shanahan Dining Commons
cards.notes: Look for the community paper during the tradition and add a brief message or drawing. It is documented as including students, staff and faculty.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide paper-message tradition at the Hoch.
cards.evidence_claim: A current HMC tour guide identifies Hoch Hearts as a Mudd tradition and says participants' paper fills with contributions from students, staff and faculty.
cards.source_title: Meet Your Tour Guides | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Check with campus dining or student life for the current occurrence and location.

cards.title: Hear Muddlore at orientation
cards.subtitle: Harvey Mudd New Student Orientation
cards.notes: If you are attending orientation, listen for the student-led retelling of campus history and ask organizers which stories are being shared that year.
cards.short_summary: An annual orientation retelling of memorable Mudd history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Muddraker describes Muddlore as a yearly New Student Orientation event in which current students recount stories from Mudd's past.
cards.access_notes: Orientation programming is for newly admitted students; confirm current schedules with Student Affairs.

cards.title: Join the September Mt. Baldy alumni hike
cards.subtitle: Harvey Mudd alumni tradition; Mt. Baldy
cards.notes: Plan only with the official Alumni Weekend information, appropriate hiking preparation and the group’s current route guidance.
cards.short_summary: A September alumni hike that began in 1997.
cards.evidence_claim: HMC's official timeline says the first Mt. Baldy alumni hike occurred in 1997 and that the tradition continues each September.
cards.access_notes: Participation, route, transportation and any fees depend on the current alumni event listing.

cards.title: Welcome the newest 50-year reunion class
cards.subtitle: Alumni Weekend, Platt Campus Center
cards.notes: At Alumni Weekend, attend the induction ceremony to see 50+ classes welcome the newest peers as they receive anniversary medals.
cards.evidence_claim: HMC's Alumni Weekend schedule calls the welcome by 50+ classes during the 50th Reunion Medal Ceremony a time-honored Mudd tradition.
cards.source_title: Alumni Weekend Schedule | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: This is scheduled as part of Alumni Weekend; see the current official schedule for eligibility and timing.

cards.title: Document, don’t disrupt, the prank tradition
cards.subtitle: Harvey Mudd College campus
cards.notes: Treat public, reversible campus humor as something to observe or photograph; follow the Honor Code and get clear permission before involving anyone.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Mudd tradition governed by a responsibility policy.
cards.evidence_claim: An official HMC post describes a well-established prank culture and says pranks must be reversible and targets must have indicated openness to being pranked.
cards.source_title: Harvey Mudd College: Mudd Minute on prank culture
cards.access_notes: Do not stage, enter, move or alter anything; comply with the College's current pranks policy and campus safety rules.

cards.title: Trace the story of Sofahenge
cards.subtitle: Liquidambar Mall
cards.notes: Use the college timeline as a starting point, then look for archival material that documents the 1996 anonymous-prank installation on the mall.
cards.short_summary: A named 1996 prank installation on Liquidambar Mall.
cards.evidence_claim: HMC's official timeline records that anonymous pranksters created “Sofahenge” on Liquidambar Mall in 1996.
cards.access_notes: Historic installation; do not recreate it or place objects on campus without permission.

cards.title: Meet Wally the Wart
cards.subtitle: Harvey Mudd College campus lore
cards.notes: Pair a campus walk with the student-paper account of Wally’s 1992 creation, and ask a current guide where this unofficial mascot appears today.
cards.short_summary: An unofficial mascot rooted in Mudd’s distinctive campus lore.
cards.evidence_claim: The Muddraker's Muddlore facts state that Wally the Wart was created in 1992.
cards.access_notes: Ask a campus guide or Student Affairs about any current public display or event use.

cards.title: Spot the long-standing unicycling tradition
cards.subtitle: Harvey Mudd College campus
cards.notes: If you see campus unicycling, observe from clear walkways and leave learning or riding to authorized, appropriately supervised settings.
cards.short_summary: Student media documented unicycling as a long-standing Mudd tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: A Muddraker article describes unicycling as a long-standing Harvey Mudd tradition.
cards.access_notes: Do not ride in pedestrian traffic; follow current campus transportation and safety rules.

cards.title: Recognize Atwood’s Hochsgiving
cards.subtitle: Atwood Dorm and Hoch-Shanahan Dining Commons
cards.notes: If the dorm announces a current gathering, join through its organizers and use the microphone moment to share a short expression of gratitude.
cards.short_summary: A dorm holiday gathering with a gratitude-sharing ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: The Muddraker reported that Atwood's holiday activities began with a dorm-wide Hochsgiving dinner, ending with residents sharing what they were thankful for.
cards.access_notes: Historical documentation from 2018; confirm that the dorm still holds it before planning around it.

cards.title: Know the North Dorm speaker-suite custom
cards.subtitle: North Dorm speaker suite
cards.notes: Treat this as dorm history rather than a cue to amplify music: ask North residents whether any current, quiet version is officially scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A North Dorm speaker-suite tradition documented by student media.
cards.evidence_claim: The Muddraker described North Dorm’s long-held “One Song Wednesday” tradition and its speaker-suite context.
cards.source_title: The Muddraker: Mudd’s Music: Speaker Suites
cards.access_notes: Historical documentation from 2017; respect residence-hall quiet hours and confirm any current practice with residents.

warnings: Several dorm-specific and historic traditions are documented by older student-media sources; cards explicitly direct users to confirm present-day occurrence.
